description: Queue a script for rendering. With wait=true (default) it waits until the video is ready and returns its links (and local paths), duration, chapters and captions; otherwise it returns the job id to poll with tourwright_job.

assets.description: Files the script refers to by name (images, music, uploads), base64-encoded

options.description: Render settings that override the script

dryRun.description: Run the script fast without voice or video, to test it

quality.description: Size of the video: sd 480p, hd 720p, fullhd 1080p, vertical 1080x1920, square 1080x1080

safe.description: A dry run that finds every element but presses, types and chooses nothing: nothing real happens in the app

voice.description: Voice for the whole video, overriding the script: a name from tourwright_voices

script.description: The script: an object, or YAML/JSON text. Read tourwright_guide first for the format.

vars.description: Values for the script variables ({{name}}): the same script makes a different video per set of values

wait.description: Wait for the video (default true); false returns the job id at once, to poll with tourwright_job

waitSeconds.description: How long to wait for the video before returning the job as it is (default 900)

name: tourwright_render
title: Render a video
